title: Song - Ode to Joy
composer: L. van Beethoven (tune of the Ninth Symphony finale)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: A tune of steps and repeated notes over block chords (G, C, D) in the left, one chord per bar.
